visual_review.failure_description: 详细静止背景prompt未改善闪动；静态ROI帧间变化约增加0.01%，基本不变。
visual_review.scope: All247 contact-sheet frames viewed; rawRGB metrics supplement global appearance, not proof of action fidelity or perceptual flicker improvement. No RGB edits.

actual_prompts_and_conditions.prompt: A continuous locked-off tripod shot from the camera viewpoint of the supplied first image. Keep the exact same rooftop background as that image for the entire video. Buildings, wall panels, window frames, roof edges, pavement lines, trees and distant objects remain rigid and motionless at exactly fixed screen positions, sizes and shapes. Keep constant daylight, exposure, white balance, color and background texture. The blonde dancer alone performs the full source-video dance in its original order and timing, with natural moving hair, clothing and cast shadow. Keep her identity, outfit and body proportions. Preserve all turns, steps and limb movements from the source video. Background surfaces stay fixed when revealed by the moving dancer. The camera remains completely stationary with constant focal length and framing. No pan, tilt, roll, zoom, shake, parallax drift, background wobble, scene morphing, flicker or exposure pulsing. Do not freeze or slow the dancer.
